name: Varan
author: hamed7ir
description: Varan is Pale Moon built for 32-bit ARM Windows, for tablets like the Surface RT and Surface 2. Pale Moon doesn't make ARM32 builds, so I made this fork. It runs on Windows RT 8.0 and 8.1 and Windows 10 ARM32. Version 1.1 is based on Pale Moon 35.0.0 (UXP RB_20260914), with ARM NEON for libvpx and ARM code for ffvpx, so 720p and 1080p video plays. Your device has to be in test-signing mode, because Windows RT won't load unsigned ARM programs otherwise. You also need the Microsoft Visual C++ 2015 or newer redistributable for ARM32. Varan is not made or supported by Moonchild Productions, so please report bugs to me, not to the Pale Moon project.
dependencies: Windows test-signing mode on the device, so the unsigned ARM programs can run.
Microsoft Visual C++ 2015 or newer redistributable for ARM32. varan.exe needs VCRUNTIME140.dll and the Universal CRT, and they are not in the package.
The vorapis v3 extension (https://vorapis.pages.dev/#/home/download), only for YouTube. It's third party and not in the package.
instructionSteps: Put the device in test-signing mode.
Install the Microsoft Visual C++ 2015 or newer redistributable for ARM32 if you don't have it. varan.exe needs VCRUNTIME140.dll and the Universal CRT.
Extract Varan-35.0.0-arm32-Setup.zip. You get a folder named Varan-Setup with Setup.exe and payload.zip in it.
Keep Setup.exe and payload.zip together and run Setup.exe. It installs for your user only, and uninstalling keeps your profile.
For YouTube, install the vorapis v3 extension from https://vorapis.pages.dev/#/home/download. It's third party and not in the package.
It's a good idea to remove the old profile from %APPDATA% (C:\Users\<you>\AppData\Roaming) and start fresh.
